title: All over the world
content:
>Lied auf Youtube anhören

Ref.:
1. All over the world the Spirit is moving,
All over the world,
as the prophet said it would be;
All over the world there's a mighty revelation
Of the glory of the Lord,
as the waters cover the sea.

2. All over the land God's Spirit is moving, ...

3. All over the church God's Spirit is moving, ...

4. All over us God's Spirit is moving, ...

5. Deep down in my heart
